title: Endpoint Fleet Hardening — Production Observability
description: Endpoint Fleet Hardening Phase 1: production fleet observability. All panels are advisory-only. No automated enforcement actions.

options.content: **Advisory Notice:** Endpoint fleet data is operational visibility only. No automated isolation, process termination, or containment is executed. All findings require analyst review.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM endpoint_agents WHERE health_state = 'online'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM endpoint_agents WHERE health_state IN ('stale', 'offline')
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM endpoint_tamper_events WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dropped_events), 0) AS value FROM endpoint_spool_snapshots WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.id) AS value FROM endpoint_agents a JOIN endpoint_agent_policy_assignments p ON a.id = p.agent_id WHERE p.applied_to_agent = false AND p.assigned_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.title: Online vs Offline Agent Trend
panels.description: Fleet health distribution over time. Advisory visibility only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', heartbeat_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE health_state = 'online') AS online, count(*) FILTER (WHERE health_state IN ('stale', 'offline')) AS stale_offline FROM endpoint_agent_heartbeats WHERE heartbeat_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT health_state AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM endpoint_agents GROUP BY health_state ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Telemetry Dropped Events Trend
panels.description: Events dropped due to spool overflow or disk pressure. Advisory — no automated action.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', recorded_at) AS time, SUM(dropped_events) AS value FROM endpoint_spool_snapshots WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Spool Utilization (bytes)
panels.description: Average spool disk usage per agent. Capped at 10 MiB (10,485,760 bytes).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', recorded_at) AS time, AVG(spool_disk_bytes) AS avg_bytes, MAX(spool_disk_bytes) AS max_bytes FROM endpoint_spool_snapshots WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tamper Events by Type
panels.description: Advisory tamper visibility events. No automated enforcement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', detected_at) AS time, tamper_type, count(*) AS value FROM endpoint_tamper_events WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, tamper_type ORDER BY 1
SELECT agent_version AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM endpoint_agents GROUP BY agent_version ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT agent_id, hostname, health_state, agent_version, ip_address, last_seen_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_seen_at))::integer AS lag_seconds FROM endpoint_agents WHERE health_state IN ('stale', 'offline') OR last_seen_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY lag_seconds DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT e.event_type, a.hostname, a.agent_id, e.agent_version, e.platform, e.ip_address, e.successful, e.occurred_at FROM endpoint_agent_enrollment_events e JOIN endpoint_agents a ON e.agent_id = a.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT a.hostname, a.health_state, s.dropped_events, s.spool_capped, s.disk_pressure, s.recorded_at FROM endpoint_spool_snapshots s JOIN endpoint_agents a ON s.agent_id = a.id WHERE s.id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM endpoint_spool_snapshots GROUP BY agent_id) AND (s.dropped_events > 0 OR s.spool_capped = true OR s.disk_pressure = true) ORDER BY s.dropped_events DESC LIMIT 20
